consequence.statement: Kyverno 1.13 gains a new capability: signatures in the sigstore bundle format can be verified using verification type `SigstoreBundle` (enabling verification of GitHub Artifact Attestations such as SLSA Provenance); the announcement states no removal, rejection, ignored setting or other change to existing behavior, so an operator who does nothing sees no operational impact.

assertion.statement: Kyverno 1.13 adds support for verifying container image signatures that use the sigstore bundle format via the new verification type `SigstoreBundle`, enabling verification of GitHub Artifact Attestations (e.g. SLSA Provenance).

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: The evidence is a feature announcement: it states no condition of an existing environment (no policy shape, key, flag, gate or version) under which anything changes, so an exposure condition cannot be derived from it.
